about.title: A dentist for people who would rather be anywhere else
paragraphs: Dr. Isaac Fernando Meta has spent 18 years building a practice around one idea: dental anxiety is not the patient's problem to solve. It is the dentist's.
That shapes everything here — from unhurried appointments and clear explanations before anything happens, to modern anaesthetic technique that keeps discomfort genuinely minimal.

He trained at the University of Buenos Aires and has since completed advanced certification in implantology and orthodontics, with continuing education every year in digital dentistry and pain management.

honest.title: Honest treatment plans
honest.description: You get every option with real prices, including the option to wait. Nothing is sold to you.

gentle.title: Genuinely gentle
gentle.description: Modern anaesthesia, unhurried pacing and a stop signal you can use at any moment.

modern.title: Modern technology
modern.description: Digital scanning, 3D imaging and same-day crowns — fewer visits, better fit.

process.title: Four steps, no surprises
process.lead: You always know what happens next, what it costs, and why it is being recommended.

one.title: Say hello
one.description: Message us on WhatsApp with what is bothering you. We reply the same day with real appointment options.

two.title: Full assessment
two.description: A 45-minute exam with digital scans and photos. We show you exactly what we see on screen.

three.title: Plan and pricing
three.description: A written plan with every option and its cost, staged so you can start where it makes sense for you.

four.title: Treatment and follow-up
four.description: Unhurried treatment, then a check-in call afterwards and a reminder when your next visit is due.

items.question: Will it hurt?
items.answer: Almost certainly less than you expect. We use modern local anaesthetic technique, work at an unhurried pace, and you have a hand signal to stop us at any moment. If you are anxious, tell us when you book and we will plan a longer, gentler first visit.

items.question: How much does a first visit cost?
items.answer: The full assessment — exam, digital scan and photos — is a fixed fee quoted to you when you book, with no add-ons. You leave with a written plan and prices, and there is no obligation to start treatment.

items.question: Do you accept insurance?
items.answer: We work with most major Argentine health plans and can issue documentation for reimbursement claims. Send us your plan details on WhatsApp and we will confirm your coverage before you come in.

items.question: How quickly can I be seen?
items.answer: Routine appointments are usually available the same week. We also hold emergency slots open every day, so urgent problems are normally seen within 24 hours.

items.question: What languages are spoken at the practice?
items.answer: Dr. Meta and his team consult in English, Spanish and Hebrew, so you can discuss your treatment in the language you are most comfortable with.

items.question: Can I bring someone with me?
items.answer: Always. A partner, friend or parent is welcome in the room for the whole appointment, and we encourage it if you are nervous.
